comment: A Spark's host checks as both clients show them: the Controller web Spark page and `vonkctl fleet detail`. The Controller owns every word (note, finding, explanation, commands, undo). The note is shown once above the checks. Each client shows a check's finding and explanation as one line, then each command on its own line, then, when there is undo, the line `Undo:` and each undo command, in order. The web test calls `hostCheckLines` and the vonkctl test calls `host_check_lines` for each case; both must equal `lines` exactly.
note: Run these on Alpha itself, in a terminal or over SSH, as a user with sudo; the Controller never changes a Spark. Advice clears on the Spark's next report (about 2 minutes). Reasons and undo steps: https://github.com/CarstVaartjes/vonk-forge/blob/main/docs/operations/spark-host-checks.md

advice.finding: Active: snapd.service, snapd.socket, snapd.seeded.service; 26 MiB in use now.

commands: sudo systemctl disable --now snapd.service snapd.socket snapd.seeded.service

advice.finding: 78.7 GiB of 116.7 GiB free is in blocks of 2 MiB or more (67%).
advice.explanation: The GPU driver takes unified memory in physically contiguous blocks of 2 MiB or more, so a load can run short while smaller free blocks remain. Compaction regroups free memory: the helper compacts once whenever loading starts on this Spark; to compact now, run this while no workload is loading.
commands: sync; echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory
